body.name: Symbolic-risk privacy-transfer handle
body.construction: Use \(H_{\mathrm{transfer}}\): rewrite a nonprivate estimator with risk within a constant of \(R_n^{\mathrm{NP}}\) into bounded local score blocks, replace every quadratic block by the exact occupancy-normalized construction in \(S_{h,\ell}\), privatize all blocks jointly, and establish an oracle inequality whose additive term is at most \(\rho_n^{\mathrm{priv}}\).
